description: Documentation for Extension.js, the framework that builds browser extensions for Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari from one manifest.json: getting started, the command reference, manifest and browser features, integrations, workflows and publishing.
rules: Extension.js needs Node.js 22.12 or newer; Node.js 18 and 20 do not work. It also runs on Deno 2.5+ and Bun 1.2+.
The default browser target is chromium and a build lands in dist/<browser>, so dist/chromium by default. extension build writes a zip only when --zip is passed.

Prefix a manifest key with a browser name when browsers differ. chromium: covers every Chromium-family target and Safari builds read it too. Since 4.1.19 chrome: means Chrome alone and edge: means Edge alone.
Write one background.service_worker in manifest.json instead of hand-writing per-browser background keys; Extension.js converts it for each browser.
package.json or deno.json marks the project root, not manifest.json. A config file is optional, and only extension.config.js, .mjs and .cjs are loaded, never .ts.
The bundler is Rspack, extended through the config hook in extension.config.js. A project needs no separate bundler config file.
Use --no-browser to skip the browser launch; --no-runner no longer exists and --no-open still launches the browser. Use --output for machine output; --format and --wait-format are deprecated.
